description: This file contains code for transforming source files, including configuration management, module resolution, source map support, and code transformation hooks, specific to the Playwright project.

methods.name: setTransformConfig
methods.description: Sets the transformation configuration including Babel plugins and external files.

methods.name: setSingleTSConfig
methods.description: Sets the path to a single TypeScript configuration file.

methods.name: singleTSConfig
methods.description: Returns the path to the current single TypeScript configuration file.

methods.name: transformHook
methods.description: Transforms source code using Babel and other preprocessors, with caching and source map support.

methods.name: requireOrImport
methods.description: Dynamically requires or imports a module, with support for source maps and dependency collection.

methods.name: wrapFunctionWithLocation
methods.description: Wraps a function to provide location information from the call stack.
